text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Groove-nee... To tell the truth, I feel 
like my progress has stalled lately...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I've tried almost all the training methods 
my father taught me and what I learned at 
the academy, but nothing really feels 
quite right—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Duramente-san... Indeed, she couldn't 
break free from the pack\nduring the 
previous mock race.\nMost likely—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Hmm. Then how about letting me observe 
Alfv's training for a day?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Alv's dedication to her training is truly 
remarkable. Looking at things from a fresh 
perspective might reveal new insights.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you looking for a training partner 
too, Alv? I believe this would be 
beneficial for you as well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I would be honored if you would accept.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I have always... held immense admiration 
for your stoic dedication.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they agreed. Good for you, 
Dura.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much...! I will definitely 
make the most of this opportunity.
